title: Song - The God of Abraham Praise (simplified)
composer: Traditional (synagogue melody for the Yigdal, tune "Leoni", adapted by M. Lyon)
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: The God of Abraham Praise (tune "Leoni") in E minor, with a one-beat pickup, over one held block chord a bar in the left (Em, D, Bm, B, Am).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-525-leoni: Leoni (hymntune from a synagogue melody for the Yigdal, transcribed by M. Lyon and adapted by T. Olivers: The God of Abraham Praise), SATB, sounding E minor; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=525)
provenance.note: Melody from Australian Hymn Book, number 53 (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=525), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
Simplified: one block chord a bar, held, with the chords of a beginner minor song only (Em, D, Bm, B, Am), instead of the full version's moving left hand.
Slower: 72 instead of 88 quarter notes a minute.
The double bar lines the source prints inside the bars at the ends of phrases are left out: the music is written in whole 4/4 bars.
Written in E minor, the key the source sounds in (the source writes it in F minor and transposes it down a semitone).
